steps.en: Install the endpoint and wire your harnesses
steps.zh: 安装端点，接上你常用的编码工具

steps.en: Registers each harness's hooks/plugins/OTLP and starts the local collector
steps.zh: 给每家 harness 注册 hook／插件／OTLP，启动本地采集器

steps.en: Work in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor as usual
steps.zh: 照常在 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 里干活

steps.en: Normalizes every session into one local trace: prompts, tools, edits, approvals, tokens
steps.zh: 把每个会话归一化成一条本地轨迹：提示词、工具、改动、批准、token

steps.en: Score a finished session and draft a candidate lesson
steps.zh: 给做完的会话打分，起草候选经验

steps.en: Ranks the trace with a consented evaluator call; nothing is written unreviewed
steps.zh: 经你同意调一次评测器给轨迹排序；未经审阅绝不落笔

steps.en: Review the candidates and approve the good ones
steps.zh: 审查候选，批准其中好的

steps.en: Installs the approved lesson as a project Agent Skill and serves memory over MCP
steps.zh: 把批准的经验装成项目 Agent Skill，并经 MCP 提供记忆

value.en: A lesson learned once in one harness is loaded by every harness — sessions stop evaporating
value.zh: 一家工具里学会的招，家家都能用——会话不再一结束就蒸发

sources: docs.beacon.sh/get-started/quickstart (brew trust asymptote-labs/tap; brew install asymptote-labs/tap/beacon; beacon endpoint install --harness claude,codex,cursor; beacon endpoint dashboard --open)
README 'Supported Agents' coverage table (hooks/plugins/OTLP/poll per runtime; sessions, prompts, tool calls, commands, file activity, approvals, MCP interactions, token usage)

docs.beacon.sh/concepts/cross-harness-memory (beacon memory evaluations run with consented evaluator call; thresholds task_success >= 0.50 and mean >= 0.60; beacon memory candidates review/approve; beacon memory skills install writes .agents/skills/<slug>/SKILL.md; beacon mcp serve exposes get_memory_context)
docs.beacon.sh/concepts/beacon-skills (skill table: recall/distill/promote and their network column; evaluator call only after the user agrees)
SECURITY.md (loopback OpenTelemetry receivers on 127.0.0.1; local runtime.jsonl with 10 MiB rotation and five archives)
